This study proposes ROOTY, a sugarcane-mycelium furniture solution.

Date: Fall,2022

︎︎︎Problem 

Nowadays, furniture recycling holds significant importance as individuals tend to replace their furniture rather than repair it.

(source:clf.org) <http://clf.org>

︎︎︎Solution

Mycelium is biodegradable and sugarcane bagasse is an abundant organic leftover, making it ideal for furniture.

Since mycelium is decomposable, and sugarcane bagasse is one of
the most abundant organic leftovers, it is an ideal material for
furniture manufacturing.

Mycelium, bagasse, and dried shredded ginger create a new material with a smoother, more appealing surface and fragrance than normal mycelium, which smells.

ROOTY specializes in offering furniture made from mycelium derived from sugarcane, such as this lamp shaped like ginger.

If the mycelium shell of the lamp becomes damaged, or scratched, or the user wants to dispose of it, they can easily break it apart ︎ by twisting and turning it, then discard the mycelium shell in their garden and recycle the electronics. The lamp's structure features an easy-break point that facilitates the removal of the electronics.

ROOTY also offers a "grow your own lamp kit" that includes dehydrated material and molds, enabling users to grow their own furniture parts.

︎︎︎Material Choice

︎︎︎Experiments

This recipe was developed through experimentation with various materials, testing their strength and durability, as well as examining their surface appearance.

<h1><span style="color: #000;">This study proposes ROOTY, a <b>sugarcane-mycelium furniture solution</b>.</span><br></h1><br>
<small>Date: Fall,2022</small><br><br><br><br>
<div class="image-gallery" data-gallery="%7B%22mode_id%22%3A6%2C%22gallery_instance_id%22%3A3%2C%22name%22%3A%22Slideshow%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22slideshow%22%2C%22data%22%3A%7B%22autoplay%22%3Atrue%2C%22autoplaySpeed%22%3A%221.9%22%2C%22speed%22%3A0.5%2C%22arrows%22%3Afalse%2C%22transition-type%22%3A%22fade%22%2C%22constrain_height%22%3Atrue%2C%22image_vertical_align%22%3A%22middle%22%2C%22image_horizontal_align%22%3A%22middle%22%2C%22image_alignment%22%3A%22image_middle_middle%22%2C%22mobile_data%22%3A%7B%22separate_mobile_view%22%3Afalse%7D%2C%22meta_data%22%3A%7B%7D%2C%22captions%22%3Atrue%7D%7D">
<img width="3175" height="1625" width_o="3175" height_o="1625" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/a9a47cdd23ce5daa2a47a10f5980caea29592a7ea5348cbf783b43ccd4f5ecc1/12-copy.png" data-mid="174520532" border="0" />
<img width="2264" height="1216" width_o="2264" height_o="1216" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/9e1ace50626445fb694124c45de202923803da08080ad063edc26d9c77203635/Screen-Shot-2023-03-11-at-2.29.54-PM.png" data-mid="171321395" border="0" />
</div><div style="text-align: left;"><br><br><br><br><br>
<br>
<h1><span style="color: #000;"><b>︎︎︎Problem </b></span></h1></div><br>
<br><br>
<br><div grid-row="" grid-pad="1" grid-gutter="2">
	<div grid-col="4" grid-pad="1"><h1><div style="text-align: center;">
</div></h1><h2>Nowadays, furniture recycling holds significant importance as individuals tend to replace their furniture rather than repair it.
</h2>
</div>
	<div grid-col="1" grid-pad="1">
<br></div>
	<div grid-col="7" grid-pad="1" class=""><img width="1240" height="430" width_o="1240" height_o="430" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/cb65297345bd8997669b8a888ab296587956213bda96e954f422594239cfe472/Mycelism.png" data-mid="174518170" border="0" data-scale="100"/><br><br><small>(source:<a href="http://clf.org" target="_blank">clf.org)</a></small><br>
<br></div>
</div><br>
<br>
<br>
<h1><span style="color: #000;"><b>︎︎︎Solution </b></span></h1>
<br>
<br>
<br><br><div grid-row="" grid-pad="1" grid-gutter="2">
	<div grid-col="4" grid-pad="1"><h2>Mycelium is <b>biodegradable</b> and sugarcane bagasse is an <b>abundant</b> organic leftover, making it ideal for furniture.

	
		
		
	
	
		
			
				
					
						<br>
Since mycelium is decomposable, and sugarcane bagasse is one of
the most abundant organic leftovers, it is an ideal material for
furniture manufacturing.<br>

					
				
			
		
	
</h2><br>
<br>
</div>
	<div grid-col="4" grid-pad="1"><div style="text-align: right"><img width="815" height="601" width_o="815" height_o="601" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/4dfd2c1f78862146f5a54f1acbdab33f1cd8f06478e14611e290ab5895b83c2d/Mycelism-1.png" data-mid="171323558" border="0" data-scale="83"/></div></div>
	<div grid-col="4" grid-pad="1"><img width="1036" height="592" width_o="1036" height_o="592" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/a9ca15113421e9fc580e90b07a16c6fff312797d058bcb99acce03075bc95923/Screen-Shot-2023-03-11-at-3.10.42-PM.png" data-mid="171324045" border="0" data-scale="100"/></div>
</div><br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<div style="text-align: center"><div grid-row="" grid-pad="0" grid-gutter="0" grid-responsive="">
	<div grid-col="4" grid-pad="0" class=""><div style="text-align: left"><h2>Mycelium, bagasse, and dried shredded ginger create a <b>new material</b> with a smoother, more appealing surface and fragrance than normal mycelium, which smells.</h2></div></div>
	<div grid-col="6" grid-pad="0" class=""><img width="6000" height="4000" width_o="6000" height_o="4000" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/2dd2b4adb81ae3803167370519d8b7f4ab3a73db8c54be3c5002e9ff3229ec06/DSC02173.JPG" data-mid="171323675" border="0" data-scale="77"/></div>
	<div grid-col="2" grid-pad="0" class=""><img width="759" height="1154" width_o="759" height_o="1154" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/c097ca4b47656ebf505e1d04f1e5239bb94fa88642cfda634bc604b25a402969/12.png" data-mid="171324292" border="0" data-scale="100"/></div>
</div></div><br><br><br>
<br>
<hr><h2><br>
ROOTY specializes in offering furniture made from mycelium derived from sugarcane, such as this lamp shaped like ginger.<br>

<br><img width="6000" height="4000" width_o="6000" height_o="4000" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/faeee4ced192a178ada27fb3fd3387e667c7ddbfd767f69adf729f0a5f0764ae/DSC01775.JPG" data-mid="165339096" border="0" /><br>
<br>
If the mycelium shell of the lamp becomes damaged, or scratched, or the user wants to dispose of it, they can easily break it apart ︎ by twisting and turning it, then discard the mycelium shell in their garden and recycle the electronics. The lamp's structure features an easy-break point that facilitates the removal of the electronics.<br>
<br>
<img width="1743" height="998" width_o="1743" height_o="998" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/ad09b691f029776fa1946c1244b540cd114d589265ba7f771c14ec2b6e33529a/12-1.png" data-mid="171325028" border="0" /><br>
<br>
ROOTY also offers a "grow your own lamp kit" that includes dehydrated material and molds, enabling users to grow their own furniture parts.</h2><br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br><div class="image-gallery" data-gallery="%7B%22mode_id%22%3A3%2C%22gallery_instance_id%22%3A4%2C%22name%22%3A%22Justify%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22justify%22%2C%22data%22%3A%7B%22image_padding%22%3A%220%22%2C%22row_height%22%3A%2239%22%2C%22variation_index%22%3A%222%22%2C%22variation%22%3A66.7%2C%22variation_mode%22%3A2%2C%22variation_seed%22%3A1%2C%22responsive%22%3Atrue%2C%22meta_data%22%3A%7B%7D%2C%22mobile_data%22%3A%7B%22image_padding%22%3A1%2C%22row_height%22%3A60%2C%22separate_mobile_view%22%3Afalse%7D%2C%22captions%22%3Atrue%7D%7D">

<img width="6000" height="4000" width_o="6000" height_o="4000" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/c66cbdbed1a6e244c00f208902307cdf0503d72f4767a23437a94d4a3416f074/DSC01784.JPG" data-mid="165339095" border="0" />
<img width="6000" height="4000" width_o="6000" height_o="4000" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/faeee4ced192a178ada27fb3fd3387e667c7ddbfd767f69adf729f0a5f0764ae/DSC01775.JPG" data-mid="165339096" border="0" />
<img width="6000" height="4000" width_o="6000" height_o="4000" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/d1878e809b87ccec2d461fe4453041eda16f9be1b604057aec9f8b925872e19e/DSC01779.JPG" data-mid="165339097" border="0" />
<img width="3024" height="4032" width_o="3024" height_o="4032" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/391379ef7b27bf3144c88fc393398ee29b49e15cba41adfa3fc879c75fb48326/IMG_3058.PNG" data-mid="165339090" border="0" />
</div><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><hr><br><br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h1><span style="color: #000;"><b>︎︎︎Material Choice</b></span></h1><br><br><br>
<br><br>
<br><img width="1191" height="1681" width_o="1191" height_o="1681" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/9f54e1aa54519b9240279a54e6d8e290e1f76137be5c7ffe82e9b111ad5bd0b0/12-2.png" data-mid="171325628" border="0" /><br>

 Date: Fall,2022

Stage Design for the one-act tragedy Salome by Oscar Wilde

Spring, 2022
Material: cord, wireframe, lightning equipment, cardboard

[click here for the complete synopsis of Salome] <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salome_(play)#Synopsis>

“....
Herod asks Salome to dance for him. She refuses, but when he promises to give her anything she wants, she agrees. Ignoring her mother's pleas – "Ne dansez pas, ma fille" – "Do not dance, my daughter"

– Salome performs the dance of the seven veils <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dance_of_the_seven_veils> .”

“Delighted, Herod asks what reward she would like, and she asks for the head of Jokanaan on a silver platter. Horrified, Herod refuses, while Herodias rejoices at Salome's choice. Herod offers other rewards, but Salome insists and reminds Herod of his promise. He finally yields. The executioner descends into the cistern, and Salome impatiently awaits her reward. When the prophet's head is brought to her, she passionately addresses Jokanaan as if he were still alive and finally kisses his lips:

Ah! j'ai baisé ta bouche, Iokanaan, j'ai baisé ta bouche. Il y avait une âcre saveur sur tes lèvres. Était-ce la saveur du sang? ... Mais, peut-être est-ce la saveur de l'amour. On dit que l'amour a une âcre saveur ... Mais, qu'importe? Qu'importe? J'ai baisé ta bouche, Iokanaan, j'ai baisé ta bouche.

Ah! I have kissed thy mouth, Jokanaan, I have kissed thy mouth. There was a bitter taste on thy lips. Was it the taste of blood? ... But perchance it is the taste of love. ... They say that love hath a bitter taste. ... But what of that? what of that? I have kissed thy mouth, Jokanaan.

Herod, frightened and appalled at Salome's behavior, orders the soldiers, "Tuez cette femme!" – "Kill that woman!", and they crush her to death under their shields.”

// The prototype of part of the scene

</span><small><span style="color: #e8e2db;">Herod asks Salome to dance for him. She refuses, but when he promises to give her anything she wants, she agrees. Ignoring her mother's pleas – "Ne dansez pas, ma fille" – "Do not dance, my daughter" <br><span style="color: #e8e2db;">
– Salome performs the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dance_of_the_seven_veils"><span style="color: #e8e2db;">dance of the seven veils</span></a>.”<br></span></span>
<br><img width="2388" height="1668" width_o="2388" height_o="1668" data-src="https://freight.cargo.site/t/original/i/7360f11a04d0dbb02523161ead991eaa7cd915d76fe610ef31565d82e869f84c/IMG_1347.PNG" data-mid="157854520" border="0" /><br>
<br><br>
<span style="color: #e8e2db;">“Delighted, Herod asks what reward she would like, and she asks for the head of Jokanaan on a silver platter. Horrified, Herod refuses, while Herodias rejoices at Salome's choice. Herod offers other rewards, but Salome insists and reminds Herod of his promise. He finally yields. The executioner descends into the cistern, and Salome impatiently awaits her reward. When the prophet's head is brought to her, she passionately addresses Jokanaan as if he were still alive and finally kisses his lips:</span><br></small><br>
